positions.name: CalibrationVerificationRecord
positions.frame: how does the observatory record establish that instrument calibration is complete and verified?
positions.why: All three expressions perform the same flat technical-report assertion that the Kestrelwood spectrograph is calibrated at 88.4 MHz and verified against June reference plates — the prose narrative (src-1) and the labelled-field headers (src-2, src-3) carry one shared directional read: a present, realis, unhedged claim of completed verification, with competence as the appealed-to good and no audience-directed performance. The structured fields restate what the prose asserts; together they form a single record of calibration status, not separate arguments.
